chapter: A Journey through States of Water
subject: Science
chapter_title: Neerin Nilai Maatrangal (A Journey through States of Water)
overview: Indha paadathula water solid, liquid, gas-nu moonu states-la irukkum. Heat kudukkumbodhum cooling pannumbodhum state eppadi maarudhu, evaporation, condensation, clouds, rain eppadi form aagudhu-nu daily-life examples moolama purinjukkolvom.
learning_objectives: Ice, liquid water, water vapour — indha moonum water-oda states-nu solla mudiyum.
Evaporation-um condensation-um eppadi different-nu explain panna mudiyum.
Heating, cooling water-oda state-ai eppadi maathudhu-nu purinjukka mudiyum.
Exposed surface area evaporation speed-ai eppadi affect pannudhu-nu solla mudiyum.
Earthen pot water-ai yen cool-aa vechikkudhu-nu explain panna mudiyum.
Clouds, rain, water cycle eppadi nadakkudhu-nu describe panna mudiyum.

teaching_sequence.title: நீரின் மூன்று நிலைகள் — 1
teaching_sequence.caption: Ice solid-aa irukkum; liquid water flow aagum; water vapour gas state-la irukkum. Ice melt aagi water-a maarum. Lemonade-la ice melt aaguradhai observe pannalaam.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Ippo "நீரின் மூன்று நிலைகள்"-ai simple example-oda purinjukkolvom. Observe panni, un words-la explain pannu; doubt irundhaa source idea-vai thirumba paapom.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Quick check: "நீரின் மூன்று நிலைகள்" pathi unakku purinjadhu enna? Oru example-oda sollu.

teaching_sequence.title: குளிர்ந்த கண்ணாடியில் நீர்த்துளிகள் — 2
teaching_sequence.caption: Ice water irukkura cold glass-oda veli surface-la droplets varum. Andha water glass-kulla irundhu leak aagala; air-la irukkura water vapour cool aagi liquid droplets-a maarudhu. Idhudhaan condensation.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Ippo "குளிர்ந்த கண்ணாடியில் நீர்த்துளிகள்"-ai simple example-oda purinjukkolvom. Observe panni, un words-la explain pannu; doubt irundhaa source idea-vai thirumba paapom.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Quick check: "குளிர்ந்த கண்ணாடியில் நீர்த்துளிகள்" pathi unakku purinjadhu enna? Oru example-oda sollu.

teaching_sequence.title: ஆவி சுருங்குதலைச் சோதித்தல் — 3
teaching_sequence.caption: Cold surface mela water droplets form aaguradhai activity moolama test pannalaam. Observation mattum podhaadhu; water veliya seep aagudha, illa air-la irundhu condense aagudha-nu evidence collect pannuvom.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Ippo "ஆவி சுருங்குதலைச் சோதித்தல்"-ai simple example-oda purinjukkolvom. Observe panni, un words-la explain pannu; doubt irundhaa source idea-vai thirumba paapom.

teaching_sequence.title: திட, திரவ, வாயு நிலைகளின் பண்புகள் — 4
teaching_sequence.caption: Solid-ku fixed shape irukkum; liquid container shape-ai eduthukkum; gas available space-la spread aagum. Water-oda moonu states-ai shape, flow, spreading base-la compare pannuvom.

teaching_sequence.title: உருகுதல், உறைதல், ஆவியாதல் — 5
teaching_sequence.caption: Heat kuduthaa ice melt aagum; liquid water-ku heat kidaikkumbodhu vapour-a maarum. Cooling panninaa water freeze aagi ice-a maarum. Plate-la water cap-ai vida seekiram dry aaguradhukku exposed area adhigam.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Ippo "உருகுதல், உறைதல், ஆவியாதல்"-ai simple example-oda purinjukkolvom. Observe panni, un words-la explain pannu; doubt irundhaa source idea-vai thirumba paapom.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Quick check: "உருகுதல், உறைதல், ஆவியாதல்" pathi unakku purinjadhu enna? Oru example-oda sollu.

teaching_sequence.caption: Water evaporate aagumbodhu surroundings-lirundhu heat edukkum. Earthen pot-oda tiny pores vazhiya water veliya vandhu evaporate aaguradhunaala pot-kulla water cool aagum.

teaching_sequence.title: மேகங்கள் மற்றும் மழை — 7
teaching_sequence.caption: Water surface-lirundhu evaporate aagi air-kku pogum. Water vapour cool aagi tiny droplets-a condense aagum; droplets serndhu clouds form aagum. Conditions poruthu rain, snow, hail varalaam.

teaching_sequence.title: நீர்ச் சுழற்சி — மீள்பார்வை — 8
teaching_sequence.caption: Ocean, rivers, soil-lirundhu water evaporate aagum; clouds-la condense aagum; rain-a thirumbi Earth-kku varum. Water flow aagi rivers moolama oceans-ai reach pannum. Idhu continuous water cycle.
